title: How Much Olive Oil Per Day? Bryan Johnson Takes 15% Of His Calories
seoTitle: How Much Olive Oil Per Day? What The Evidence Shows
excerpt: Bryan Johnson drinks three tablespoons a day and calls it 15% of his calories. The study he cites measured half a tablespoon. What the evidence supports.
seoDescription: How much olive oil per day? Bryan Johnson takes 3 tablespoons. The evidence flattens around 20 g, and concentration decides how much you need to swallow.
